perl's branch reset numbers each alternative's groups from the same start: /(?|(a)|(b))/ sets $1 on either branch.  cl-ppcre has no (?| form.  A translation is possible for the capture-less case (?|a|b) == (?:a|b); with captures the group numbering must be remapped (each alternative's k-th group -> one shared register), which cl-ppcre cannot express directly -- candidates: rewrite to (?:(a)|(b)) and fold the registers after the match in %p-match-record, or a filter.  Not on any other task (the 'branch reset' hit in the store is #672, unrelated).
